verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a dedicated model-ID versioning page distinguishing pinned versioned IDs from dateless/moving alias forms, backed by a separate deprecation policy with per-model retirement floors and migration guidance, plus a /v1/models endpoint for programmatic discovery of exact IDs. This directly matches the story's requirement of pinning exact versions while aliases track latest releases with documented policy. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of alias behavior in practice, and no explicit worked example showing an alias resolving to a new version over time.
